features: olive skin, dark hair flattened by the helmet, dark eyes, lean angular face, full dark beard, wiry build, steady unsmiling gaze, soft leather helmet with large round goggles pushed up on the brow, white linen overalls
bio: The older Camardelli, and the one who reads a road. Learned the trade on the Argentine dirt classics, where a broken spring meant a night by the roadside with a hammer, and came to Europe in 1921 with a mechanic's hands and no contract. Molsheim took him on for the Type 32 — the tank — a car nobody else wanted to be seen in. He drives it the way he drives everything: quietly, and further than the machine wants to go.
